digest.component_or_area: eval specs, eval solver, gold-set expectations
propositions: Eval specs and gold-set expectations contain dual vocabulary (Acceptance Criteria and Success Criteria headings) that must be collapsed to a single unified vocabulary
eval_solver.py generates fixture descriptions with duplicate criterion text under both Acceptance Criteria and Success Criteria headings, reintroducing vocabulary that reviewer prompts no longer use
Gold-set expectation strings reference success criteria phrasing that no longer aligns with the updated rubric after vocabulary consolidation
Updated fixtures and expectations must preserve gold-set pass/fail tallies and scoring behavior while changing only vocabulary
Vocabulary carve-outs in plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier.md, and dod_uncertifiable context must be left unchanged as they refer to generic English rather than the ticket heading convention
Acceptance criteria checks must account for four permanent vocabulary exclusions to avoid false positives on blanket string prohibition tests
